run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest prime factor of a given integer n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple inputs to verify correct largest prime factor results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a different algorithm for finding the largest prime factor
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold computes the largest prime factor by trial division up to sqrt of n
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like prime inputs or powers of two
